rationale: The evaluator feedback on iteration 2 candidate approved the trend of reducing kp and increasing kd to improve damping and reduce steering oscillations. However, it suggested that if oscillations persist despite high kd, slightly increasing kp and lowering kd might improve responsiveness and avoid sluggishness. Also, if progress is low or unstable at base_speed 1.7, reducing it slightly to 1.6 could help. Based on this, I adjusted kp from 2 to 3 to improve responsiveness, kd from 10 to 9 to reduce potential sluggishness, and base_speed from 1.7 to 1.6 to balance speed and stability. The integral gain ki remains at 0.5, sensor weights and line loss strategy remain unchanged as no issues were reported. Geometry is unchanged, preserving the stable physical setup. I expect these changes to reduce any residual oscillations while maintaining good progress and stability. I request measurements of completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify these effects in the next race.
